stem:
Read this quotation from paragraph 9 of the selection "A Legacy of Stone."

"Whatever your age, whatever you wish to achieve, if you are courageous, persistent, and hardworking, you are sure to succeed."

What can the reader infer from this quotation?

options.label: F
options.text: Cheval did not realize it would take him 33 years to complete his project.

options.label: G
options.text: Cheval is surprised that his interest in rocks led him to create a masterpiece.

options.label: H
options.text: Cheval had specific traits that helped him achieve his goal.

options.label: J
options.text: Cheval is an independent artist and did not want others to help him.

visual_elements: quotation box containing: "Whatever your age, whatever you wish to achieve, if you are courageous, persistent, and hardworking, you are sure to succeed."
